patterns.note: Full-width sections with generous vertical spacing create a sense of airiness and clear content hierarchy.
A distinctive, wide, rounded sans-serif is used for the primary brand logo and large display headings, contrasting with a more standard, clean sans-serif for body text and navigation.
A stark black and white base palette is consistently used for backgrounds and text, with vibrant, often gradient-filled, abstract 3D graphics providing the primary color accents.
The initial oversized hero logo and text animate out of view on scroll, revealing a compact, sticky header that persists at the top of the page.
Content sections, such as the 'WORK' grid and feature blocks, are revealed with a subtle fade-in or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport during scrolling.
The 'WORK' section features a horizontal tab navigation to filter project categories, presented above a grid of project thumbnails.

technique_notes: The site employs a scroll-triggered animation system, likely utilizing GSAP ScrollTrigger, to manage the dynamic appearance and disappearance of elements. This includes the initial hero content scrolling away and subsequent content sections revealing with a subtle fade-up or slide-in effect as they become visible.
A sticky header is implemented, which is initially hidden or part of the larger hero, but becomes fixed at the top of the viewport after a specific scroll depth, providing persistent navigation.
Abstract, high-fidelity 3D rendered graphics are integrated as hero elements and within content sections, providing visual interest and a modern, tech-forward aesthetic against a minimalist backdrop.

design_tokens.type_scale: oversized, wide sans-serif hero text (~4-5x body) with bold, wide sans-serif headings (~2-3x body) and smaller, uppercase labels.
design_tokens.spacing: airy, with significant vertical padding between major sections and a balanced density within content blocks.

standout: The site's distinctive feature is its bold integration of highly stylized, vibrant 3D abstract motion graphics with a stark, minimalist black-and-white interface. This creates a sophisticated and modern aesthetic that feels both cutting-edge and clean, elevating the visual experience beyond typical agency sites.
